blocks.summary: Dataset scale, licensing, hosting, benchmark, and JiT reference baseline.
Modern visual generation has rapidly increasing data and dense-conditioning requirements.
ImageNet-1K is increasingly misaligned with current practice and its FID is saturated.
Motivation and four benchmark properties: permissive, stable, large, and accessible.
GPIC overview: 27.97T pixels, split sizes, 8000 shards, construction and evaluation protocol.
Four-stage construction overview.
Flickr and Wikimedia source pool, accepted licenses, retained attribution, and 110,569,761 initial images.
Resolution, aspect-ratio, VLM quality, and safety filters with removal rates.
SSCD features, FAISS nearest neighbors, manual threshold calibration, and conservative pair removal.
Power-law image collision models across thresholds and subset sizes.
Two-tier full-corpus deduplication rule, final 101.3M count, and SHA-256 exact-duplicate check.
Synthetic VLM captions replace noisy or missing source metadata.
Tag, short, medium, and long caption formats and their corpus proportions.
Qwen3-VL model selection and construction of a 1520-image captioning microbenchmark.
Five judging axes, quality-throughput tradeoff, and approximately 1500 H100 GPU-hours.
Reproducibility pointers to the exact caption and judge prompts.
100M/200K/1M train-validation-test partition and preserved source/caption distributions.
Nested Nano, Lite, and Full benchmark scales.
Tar packaging, 8000 balanced shards, and streaming-training rationale.
A human-aligned and less saturated evaluation setting.
FD-DINOv2, Precision, Density, Recall, and Coverage metrics.
Fixed 50K captions, 1M-image reference statistics, and gpic-eval toolkit.
Held-out test statistics instead of training-set statistics.
Real-vs-real oracle references for interpreting model performance and monitoring saturation.
Protocol warning against training objectives aligned to DINOv2 or FD-DINOv2.
Disclosure expectations for auxiliary networks, prompt rewriting, and text encoders.
JiT-T2I pixel-space flow-matching reference baseline.
One-epoch 256x256 training hyperparameters and 8xH100 runtime.
50-step Euler sampling and CFG scales 1.75, 4.0, and 6.25.
Quantitative results and best FD 76.25 at CFG 6.25.
Summary of GPIC design, release, and intended research use.
Misuse, memorization, bias, legal provenance, frozen shards, and residual near-duplicates.
Compute, manuscript feedback, and discussion acknowledgments.
References 1-37 retained in searchable bibliographic form.
Appendix A-F contents.
Additional GPIC image-caption examples at all four caption granularities.
Center-crop and Pillow bicubic downsampling protocol for ImageNet-256 and GPIC-256.
Additional oracle metrics over Inception-v3 and FD mean/covariance components.
Motivation for ablating DINOv2 backbone size and register tokens.
Register variants alter absolute FD scale through feature-range and variance changes.
Evaluator agreement and selection of non-register ViT-L/14 as default.
Additional low-resolution and poor-quality filtering examples.
Deduplication examples across similarity tiers and cluster sizes.
1520-image microbenchmark sampling and human caption correction process.
Tag, short, medium, and long VLM-versus-human error examples.
List of exact captioning and judge prompt tasks.
Exact tag-style caption prompt and full Chinese translation.
Exact short-caption prompt and full Chinese translation.
Exact medium-caption prompt and full Chinese translation.
Exact long-caption prompt and full Chinese translation.
Exact LLM-as-a-judge evaluation prompt and full Chinese translation.
Interpretation of the paper's real contribution, strongest scientific choice, and unresolved risks.
